authority: Repository software, ranking-loss mathematics and executable synthetic regressions only
defect: Anchor sampled from either winning or losing labels, but softplus(-(si-sj)) always pushed the anchor above its opposite-label partner. Losing anchors therefore reversed the intended ordering and contradicted PairRank evaluation.
fix: After sampling an opposite-label partner, swap indices when the anchor label is a loss; ForwardLogit and BackwardFrom consistently use winner then loser. Preserve sampling, pair membership and weighting. Record pairObjective winner-minus-loser/v1.

objective.verification: Central differences of a separate double-precision loss evaluator versus actual saved one-epoch parameter updates. No analytic backprop copied into the numerical oracle.

reviewed_prior_scope.disposition: Closes the open negative-label anchor direction review for the scoped pair-loop correction. Retains the historical report and original bindings unchanged; does not promote previous software or game-rule evidence.

worker.verification: Primary checked source against exact base Git blob and hash/line count, and all 16 literal citations. Worker purpose prose is source inventory only; correctness follows primary math review and executable tests.

validation_environment.source: Clean HEAD src/BotSim/NNTrain plus Program and new PairDirectionSelfTest; unrelated dirty action-probe code excluded.
validation_environment.runtime_data_note: Exact runtime data bytes satisfy native-default proof; normalized content matches HEAD. Matrix provenance uses exact Git bytes separately.

remaining: Software pair-ranking objective and gradient correction only; no card/native rule certification, throughput or playing-strength claim.

Regression covers one synthetic matchup/turn cell with repeated class-identical observations, two game split seeds and two sampling modes. It does not establish arbitrary multi-cell or general optimizer numerical correctness.

Finite differences check all four active-feature W1 entries, four B1 entries and four W2 entries at one initial point for eight one-step cases. Tolerance 2e-6; perturbation 1e-5. Other W1 dimensions are inactive in this fixture.
Row reorder invariance is specific to class-identical repeated observations and fixed game membership, checked within 2e-6. Arbitrary dataset reordering can legitimately change SGD sampling.
The old win/BCE parameter fingerprint matches for the fixed synthetic win case; metadata additionally contains pairObjective, null for win. No universal byte-identical model claim.

Old pair models must be retrained to benefit from this fix; adding metadata or verifying an old holdout does not repair learned weights. Existing policy consumers reject pair targets and are unchanged.
Pair validation without held-out ranking pairs still uses the existing 0.5 fallback; truthful reporting of unavailable ranking metrics remains open. No earlier evidence bindings are refreshed.
